title: Parent-type/phase nodes with legal run edges empty a transition or make G_anc a DAG
statement: The directed graph whose nodes are first-collision parent-type/phase states (pi, phi, tag) and whose edges are legal O^a E^r runs empties a transition both (a,r) types allow, or is a DAG, for a reason that is not the archived run-type graph G_run and not the four-position intersection taxonomy.
counterexamples: first-collision OO count 0 on [13,2001); MULTI count 0; every length>=2 occupancy hit reduces to a one-step parent
forgetful projection matches realized_transition_graph: 48 nodes, 214 edges, OOE self-loop, CycleMin-shaped subgraph cyclic
valley nodes are EE|V|ARCHIVED_EE, EO|V|ARCHIVED_EO, OE|V|ARCHIVED_EO; G_anc has 3 nodes, 4 edges, and a directed cycle; n_new_empty=0
letter-level phase edges are the eight-run-form necklace V / O_int / P / E_int
365=(2,1)^4 then (1,3) versus 1517=(2,1)^3 then (1,1), both EE|V|ARCHIVED_EE on the shared prefix; J-block-map-q-state
notes: Phase 0 only. Not a halt theorem and not a leftover-killer. Nodes are not (a,r). One-step EE/EO/OO are archived. The lift forgets to G_run and to the four-position taxonomy. No finance, no K=11, no L=55293, no floor raise. No Paper A edit, no ledger row, no new Lean.
tested_range: occupancy and G_anc on odds in [13,2001), letter cap 80; CycleMin 2+2 and ee_entry_count at n=10^6+1; controls 365 and 1517
